menu.onlyEmpty: Only an empty namespace can be deleted.

delete.title: Delete namespace {{namespace}}?
delete.text: Only an empty namespace can be deleted. The grants given on it are revoked.

external.title: New external table in {{namespace}}
external.name: Name
external.nameText: The table's name, without its namespace.
external.locationText: Files under raw/: a directory and a file pattern, such as raw/orders/*.csv. The table reads the matching files directly in that directory, and no other external table may use it. At least one file must match: Lakana reads one to learn the columns.

note.notShown: Created namespace {{namespace}}. You may not read the namespaces of {{environment}}, so the tree does not show it while it holds no table you may read.
note.artifactDropped: Dropped artifact {{artifact}}. Its files are removed from storage, and Lakana's periodic clean-up removes any it could not.
